description: Firebase Remote Config implementation for FireForNet SDK
releaseNotes:
v1.0.1-preview.6
- Redesigned IFirebaseRemoteConfig.OnConfigUpdatedAsync to use awaited Task-returning update and error callbacks, so applications can activate fetched realtime values without fire-and-forget work.
- Realtime subscribers now await update callbacks and route callback failures to the async error callback when one is registered.

v1.0.1-preview.5
- Fixed parameterless FetchAsync to hydrate persisted settings before applying the default minimum fetch interval.
- Fixed OnConfigUpdatedAsync to initialize the realtime lifecycle monitor before subscribing, matching Blazor foreground/background ownership.
- Added FirebaseRemoteConfigBuilder.RealtimeConnectTimeout and now honors configured RealtimeMaxRetries in the realtime reconnect loop.
- Added RealtimeConnectTimeout to ConfigSettings and FirebaseRemoteConfigOptions (default 5 minutes).
- Separated realtime streaming connection timeout from regular fetch timeout, matching Android/iOS/JS SDK behavior where long-lived streamFetchInvalidations connections use no client-side timeout.
- ConnectRealtimeAsync now uses RealtimeConnectTimeout instead of FetchTimeout, preventing premature timeout on platforms where HttpClient.Timeout applies (native .NET MAUI/Desktop/WinUI).

v1.0.1-preview.4
- Synchronized package version with the preview.4 release.
- Moved IRealtimeLifecycleMonitor initialization from RealtimeListener stream startup to IFirebaseRemoteConfig.EnsureReadyAsync and OnConfigUpdatedAsync for correct lifecycle ownership

v1.0.1-preview.3
- Fixed realtime stream parsing: replaced line-based StreamReader.ReadLineAsync with raw byte accumulation and JSON brace-boundary detection, matching Android/JS/iOS SDKs.
- Fixed realtime message deserialization: latestTemplateVersionNumber is sent as a quoted string by the server, not a bare number.
- Added reconnection retry with exponential backoff (base 60s, 2x multiplier, ±50% jitter, max 8 retries) matching Android/JS.
- Added fetch retry on invalidation: up to 3 attempts with random 0-4s delay, comparing fetched template version against target version (matching Android/JS autoFetch).
- Fixed retryIntervalSeconds handling: server-specified delay now correctly delays reconnection instead of being wasted.
- Added IRealtimeLifecycleMonitor contract for background/foreground lifecycle management. No-op default registered by AddFirebaseRemoteConfig(); integration packages provide platform implementations.
- Added RealtimeRetryLimitExceeded error code for exhausted retry budget.

v1.0.1-preview.2
- Added X-Google-GFE-Can-Retry and X-Accept-Response-Streaming headers to realtime stream requests for parity with Android/iOS SDKs.
- Added X-Firebase-RC-Fetch-Type, X-Google-GFE-Can-Retry, and X-Accept-Response-Streaming headers unconditionally from core; browser platforms strip them via integration-layer interceptors.
- Fixed CORS preflight failure on Blazor WASM by moving platform-specific header filtering to the Blazor integration package.

v1.0.1-preview.1
- Added platform store integration support (Blazor, Browser, Sqlite, Windows, Maui) via segregated store interfaces.
- InMemoryRemoteConfigStore remains the default when no platform store is registered.
- Bumped to preview10.
